title: Which glasses? / Give me some...
subtitle: 哪几只玻璃杯？/ 给我一些……

lead.question: 要几只长得像的玻璃杯，你用英语怎么指明「架子上的那几只」而不是「这几只」？
lead.warmup: 第 21 课用 one 代替单数 a book，这一课升级到复数：some glasses 用 ones 代替。丈夫让 Jane 拿几只玻璃杯，Jane 问 Which glasses?，丈夫说不是 those，是架子上的 the ones on the shelf。注意 ones 前面也能加 the 和定语。先看图，试着说「电视机上那几本杂志」用英语怎么表达。
goals: 能用 Give me some … please. 请求复数物品
能用 Which glasses? / Which ones? 询问「哪几只/哪些」
能用 ones 代替复数名词，并加 the 与定语（on the shelf）
能用人称代词宾格作双宾语（直接宾语 + 间接宾语）
lead.summary: 第 23 课是取玻璃杯的复数版对话：Give me some glasses please. → Which glasses? → These glasses? → No, not those. The ones on the shelf. 第 24 课把 Give me some … please. 铺开十组（pens、ties、spoons…），操练 Which ones? These? No, not those. The ones on the ___.
lead.tips: ① some glasses 复数，用 ones 代替；② The ones on the shelf 是省略句（省 I want），ones = glasses，on the shelf 介词短语作定语；③ These? = Do you want these? 省略句；④ Yes, please. 表同意要某物，No, thank you. 表不要；⑤ 双宾语：Give me some glasses 中 me 间接宾语，glasses 直接宾语，人称代词作宾语用宾格。

questions.q: Which glasses does the man want?
questions.hint: 听 No, not those. The ones on the shelf.

questions.q: What does the husband ask Jane to give him first?
questions.hint: Give me some glasses please, Jane.

questions.q: Does the husband want the glasses Jane first shows (these)?
questions.zh: 丈夫要简先拿的那几只（these）吗？
questions.a: No. He wants the ones on the shelf.
questions.aZh: 不要，他要架子上的那些。
questions.hint: No, not those. The ones on the shelf.

questions.q: When the wife offers the glasses again, what does the husband say?
questions.zh: 妻子又把杯子递过来时，丈夫怎么回答？
questions.hint: 表示同意要某物用 Yes, please.

questions.q: Why can 'ones' replace 'glasses' in 'The ones on the shelf'?
questions.zh: 为什么 The ones on the shelf 里 ones 能代替 glasses？
questions.a: ones is the plural of the pronoun one, standing for the plural noun glasses to avoid repetition; on the shelf is a prepositional phrase modifying ones.
questions.aZh: ones 是 one 的复数，代替复数名词 glasses 避免重复；on the shelf 是修饰 ones 的介词短语。
questions.hint: 想想中文「架子上的那几只」也没说「的玻璃杯」。

questions.q: Give me some pens please. Which ones? These? No, not those. The ones on the desk. / Give me some ties please. Which ones? These? No, not those. The ones on the chair.
questions.zh: 第 24 课操练：请给我一些……。（把物品与位置配对问一遍）
questions.a: Give me some bottles please. Which ones? These? No, not those. The ones on the dressing table.
questions.aZh: 请给我一些瓶子。哪些？这些吗？不，不是那些。梳妆台上的那些。
questions.hint: ones 代替复数名词，前面可加 the/these/those。

meanings.usage: 表示在某平面（看似平面）之上

examples.en: The bottles on the dressing table.
The plate is on the table.

grammar.title: 不定代词 ones（复数替代）
grammar.definition: ones 是 one 的复数，代替复数可数名词，避免重复。前面可加 the/these/those 与定语。The ones on the shelf 中 ones = glasses。
grammar.usage: 在已知范围内挑选某些（复数）。

examples.en: No, not those. The ones on the shelf.
examples.zh: 不，不是那些。是架子上的那几只。

examples.en: Which ones? These? No, not those.
examples.zh: 哪些？这些吗？不，不是那些。

grammar.title: on 引导的介词短语（表面之上）
grammar.structure: 名词 + on + 表面名词
grammar.definition: on 表示「在（平面）表面之上」。the pens on the desk（桌上的钢笔），the boxes on the floor（地板上的盒子）。
grammar.usage: 描述物体位于某平面上方。

examples.en: the bottles on the dressing table

drill.q: Give me some ___ please. Which ones? These? No, not those. The ones on the ___.
drill.zh: 请给我一些……。哪些？这些吗？不，不是那些。在……上的那些。（把下面 10 组物品与位置挨个问一遍）
answers: Give me some pens please. Which ones? These? No, not those. The ones on the desk.
Give me some ties please. Which ones? These? No, not those. The ones on the chair.

quiz.q: "Give me some glasses please." 中 some 表示：
quiz.zh: some 在这里是什么意思？
quiz.note: some 接复数/不可数名词表示「一些」，此处 glasses 复数。

quiz.q: "The ones on the shelf." 中 ones 代替：
quiz.note: ones 是 one 的复数，代替前文复数名词 glasses。
on 表示在某平面之上，如 on the shelf（架子上）。

quiz.q: "Which glasses?" 的完整形式最接近：
quiz.zh: Which glasses? 的完整形式是？
quiz.note: 省略特殊疑问句，完整为 Which glasses do you want?

quiz.q: 别人递东西问你要不要，你同意应说：
quiz.note: 同意要某物用 Yes, please.；No, thank you. 表不要。

quiz.q: "The ones on the shelf." 是哪种句子？
quiz.note: 句首省略了 I want，ones 后 on the shelf 作定语。
